      organization.assign_attributes(profile_image: "")

      expect(organization.valid?).to be(false)
      expect(organization.errors[:profile_image]).to be_present
    end

    it "detaches Active Storage profile_image on User when explicitly set to nil", :aggregate_failures do
      user = create(:user, profile_image: image_jpg)
      expect(user.profile_image).to be_attached

      user.update!(profile_image: nil)
      expect(user.profile_image).not_to be_attached
      expect(user.profile_image_url).to be_nil
    end
  end

  describe "string assignment handling" do
    it "attaches an Active Storage blob when given a valid signed_id" do
      blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(
        io: image_jpg.open,
        filename: "signed.jpg",
        content_type: "image/jpeg",
      )
      user = create(:user, profile_image: blob.signed_id)

      expect(user.profile_image).to be_attached
      expect(user.profile_image.blob).to eq(blob)
    end

    it "ignores non-signed URL strings without raising InvalidSignature" do
      user = build(:user, profile_image: Settings::General.mascot_image_url)
      expect(user.valid?).to be(true)
      expect(user.profile_image).not_to be_attached
    end
  end

  describe "remote_profile_image_url=" do
    it "downloads and attaches remote image to Active Storage without CarrierWave", :aggregate_failures do
      url = "https://example.com/avatar.png"
      stub_request(:get, url).to_return(
        status: 200,
        body: File.binread(image_png.path),
        headers: { "Content-Type" => "image/png" },
      )

      expect(CarrierWave::Downloader::Base).not_to receive(:new)

      user = create(:user, profile_image: nil, remote_profile_image_url: url)

      expect(user.profile_image).to be_attached
      expect(user.remote_profile_image_url).to eq(url)
      expect(user.profile_image.filename.to_s).to eq("avatar.png")
    end

    it "follows redirects when downloading a remote image" do
      initial_url = "https://example.com/redirect-avatar"
      final_url = "https://cdn.example.com/final-avatar.png"
      stub_request(:get, initial_url).to_return(status: 302, headers: { "Location" => final_url })
      stub_request(:get, final_url).to_return(
        status: 200,
        body: File.binread(image_png.path),
        headers: { "Content-Type" => "image/png" },
      )

      user = create(:user, profile_image: nil, remote_profile_image_url: initial_url)

      expect(user.profile_image).to be_attached
      expect(user.profile_image.filename.to_s).to eq("final-avatar.png")
    end

    it "adds a validation error when remote download fails", :aggregate_failures do
      url = "https://example.com/missing.png"
      stub_request(:get, url).to_return(status: 404, body: "")

      user = build(:user, profile_image: nil, remote_profile_image_url: url)

      expect(user.valid?).to be(false)
      expect(user.errors[:profile_image]).to be_present
    end

    it "adds a validation error when remote URL has an invalid scheme", :aggregate_failures do
      user = build(:user, profile_image: nil, remote_profile_image_url: "ftp://example.com/avatar.png")

      expect(user.valid?).to be(false)
      expect(user.errors[:profile_image]).to be_present
    end

    it "attaches a File when passed a File (e.g. from SafeRemoteProfileImageUrl)" do
      file = Images::SafeRemoteProfileImageUrl.call(nil)
      user = create(:user, profile_image: nil, remote_profile_image_url: file)

      expect(user.profile_image).to be_attached
    ensure
      file&.close
    end
  end

  describe "validations" do
    it "rejects unsupported formats like pdf", :aggregate_failures do
      user = build(:user, profile_image: image_pdf)

      expect(user.valid?).to be(false)
      expect(user.errors[:profile_image]).to be_present
    end

    it "rejects images larger than MAX_PROFILE_IMAGE_SIZE", :aggregate_failures do
      stub_const("ProfileImageable::MAX_PROFILE_IMAGE_SIZE", 2.megabytes)
      large_image = fixture_file_upload("large_profile_img.jpg", "image/jpeg")
      user = build(:user, profile_image: large_image)

      expect(user.valid?).to be(false)
      expect(user.errors.full_messages).to include("Profile image File size should be less than 2 MB")
    end

    it "rejects images exceeding max pixel dimensions", :aggregate_failures do
      allow(FastImage).to receive(:size).and_return([5000, 5000])
      user = build(:user, profile_image: image_jpg)

      expect(user.valid?).to be(false)
      expect(user.errors[:profile_image]).to be_present
    end
  end

  describe "EXIF removal" do
    before { described_class.enable_processing = true }
    after { described_class.enable_processing = false }

    it "strips EXIF and GPS data when saving to Active Storage", :aggregate_failures do
      expect(EXIFR::JPEG.new(image_with_gps.path).exif?).to be(true)
      expect(EXIFR::JPEG.new(image_with_gps.path).gps.present?).to be(true)

      user = create(:user, profile_image: image_with_gps)
      downloaded = Tempfile.new(["downloaded", ".jpg"])
      downloaded.binmode
      downloaded.write(user.profile_image.download)
      downloaded.flush

      expect(EXIFR::JPEG.new(downloaded.path).exif?).to be(false)
      expect(EXIFR::JPEG.new(downloaded.path).gps.present?).to be(false)
    ensure
      downloaded&.close!
    end
  end

  describe "callbacks on Active Storage profile image changes" do
    it "busts profile image cache when a User uploads a new Active Storage picture" do
      user = create(:user)

      sidekiq_assert_enqueued_with(job: Users::BustProfileImageCacheWorker, args: [user.id]) do
        user.update!(profile_image: image_png)
      end
    end

    it "enqueues social image generation when a User with published articles changes profile picture" do
      user = create(:user)
      create(:article, user: user, published: true)
      allow(Images::SocialImageWorker).to receive(:perform_async)

      user.update!(profile_image: image_png)

      expect(Images::SocialImageWorker).to have_received(:perform_async).with(user.id, "User")
    end
  end
end
